title: Putting a picture on a page: deselect first
text: place_image fills the currently SELECTED empty or graphic frame, for example the background rectangle you just drew. Run edit.deselectAll first, then place_image {path, x, y, width}; the width argument alone does not size the frame, so select the new frame and use transform.set {x, y, width, height, ref: 0} and object.fit {mode: fitContentToFrame}.
keys: put a picture on the page

title: Before calling a layout finished: check it
text: Run craftmcp.py check designcraft (preflight: overset text, missing fonts, low-resolution images; plus items off the page and characters a font has no glyph for), then render a page and look at the image.

title: Characters missing from a font are silently drawn with another font
text: DesignCraft draws characters the chosen font lacks (for example Cyrillic in a Latin-only typeface) with a fallback face and does not report a missing font: font.list and preflight show nothing. craftmcp.py check designcraft compares the text with the font files' glyph tables and names the letters.

title: Long jobs belong in a script on the control channel
text: A whole book or hundreds of commands: run a script against the app's control port instead of MCP calls, for example DESIGNCRAFT_PORT=$(craftmcp.py port designcraft) python projects/book_build/build.py <manifest>.

title: New frames come with a thin dark stroke
text: frame.create gives frames a default stroke. Remove it with object.stroke {swatch: 'None', ids: [frame ids]}; set a fill with object.fill {swatch, ids} after swatch.create.
